items.prompt:
Writing should match its task, purpose, and:
A) audience
B) page color
C) font size

steps: Fit the reader. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Writing that flows logically and connects ideas is:
A) coherent
B) random
C) off-topic

A formal research report should use a:
A) formal, objective style
B) slangy style
C) joking style

Which opening best fits a FORMAL letter to a city council?
A) 'Dear Members of the Council,'
B) 'Hey folks!'
C) 'Sup,'

What makes a paragraph coherent?
A) sentences connect logically and stay on one idea
B) random unrelated facts
C) no transitions
items.answer: A) sentences connect logically and stay on one idea

solution.answer: A) sentences connect logically and stay on one idea

items.prompt:
If your audience is experts in a field, your writing can:
A) use precise technical vocabulary
B) avoid all key terms
C) be very vague

steps: Match the audience. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A student writes a formal lab report but keeps adding casual jokes. The main problem is that the STYLE does not match the:
A) task and audience
B) page count
C) spelling

Which revision most improves COHERENCE?
A) adding transitions so each idea leads logically to the next
B) adding unrelated facts
C) deleting all paragraph breaks
items.answer: A) adding transitions so each idea leads logically to the next

steps: Transitions aid flow. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) adding transitions so each idea leads logically to the next
